item.title: Planning a Holiday in Lagos? It’s Great for a Day Trip, But Connoisseurs Stay 15 Minutes Away. Why?
item.description: Looking for the best alternative to Lagos in the Algarve? Praia da Luz and Burgau, 15 minutes west, offer resort beaches, a seafront promenade and quiet village life.

item.title: Winter Sun in the Western Algarve: Why Burgau and Luz Shine from November to February
item.description: Mild afternoons, nearly ten hours of daylight and a coastline made for walking, cycling and golf.
